transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. I've called this meeting to close out the Bay 4 hydrogen alarm incident so we can get overnight charging capacity back online. As we all know, Bay 4 had a hydrogen alarm during the afternoon shift. The alarm has reset and there's no visible damage, but we need charging capacity for six forklifts tonight, and Bay 2 is available as a temporary alternative. Before I can authorize any charging plan, I need to hear from facilities maintenance and from EHS per our incident-closeout routine. Could facilities maintenance please give your report first?
